commit.message:
refactor: identity provider and session management

- Updated userinfo retrieval in IdentityProviderService to use capped JSON reading.
- Changed user resolution method in DefaultIdentityService to resolve credentials more effectively.
- Enhanced authorization server metadata to include introspection scope.
- Added API key revocation during password reset to enhance security.
- Introduced AuthenticatorChanged event to notify about changes in authentication factors.
- Modified login flow to ensure MFA tokens are tied to the correct client.
- Improved error handling for refresh tokens and session management.
- Updated session editing to preserve device information during token rotation.
- Added tests to ensure consistent behavior for sign-up and login processes, including handling of existing accounts and IP lockout mechanisms.
- Enhanced token introspection and refresh token handling to align with RFC 6749 specifications.
